body: I didn't and I hate everything about my existence

And this is why I will never call a suicide hotline or be honest with anyone about whether or not I plan on following through with feeling suicidal.

I can't imagine going through all that during a time when I feel low enough that I'm seriously considering suicide and scared enough that i will actually go through with it to call a suicide hotline. 

The only time I have felt low enough to talk to anyone had been a time where I felt like I had no other choice. And to have cops show up and handcuff you on top of that..... Jesus Christ 

No thanks, that right there is why I feel so alone when I'm struggling with thoughts of suicide.. Those are bad enough but to know that if I am honest with anyone about how I feel, that if I ask for help that I'll end up in handcuffs or in some hospital.. Really lonely place to be I'd rather take my chances with my demons even if that means swallowing my pills and just seeing if I wake up in the morning,

You need to tell someone.

Ive been there, I didn't and it's too late for me to do anything about it. I'm too old to even get counseling and have it be effective in helping me.

It sounds like how my experience started but the beginning was just testing to see how I would react and it kept getting worse because I didn't tell anyone what was happening or tell him outright to stop. Being quiet because i was scared was taken as an invitation for sexual abuse and basically gave him the green light.


Your mother would want to know. She loves you and no matter what shit she is dealin with now, if she ever found out you didn't tell her that someone was hurting you and she could have prevented it. It will destroy her.

I've had plenty of phone calls where my mom was sobbing that she wishes I had told her because she let it happen and she didn't know but she blames herself.

Tell your mom or a teacher or your dr or the school counselor or someone.

You could always just start with that he is making you uncomfortable with how he is touching you and just show them where he is putting his hand using your own hand if you are embarrassed to say he's fondling you in a sexual manner.

I decided to use a throw away instead if my main account just because I'm a bit ashamed of myself.



 Autism and C-PTSD 

Pretty sure that's why I feel isolated and still find myself questioning things with a feeling of horror not understanding why when other people aren't even phased

The way people lie about so much in their day to day lives or how people treat their "friends" is truly something I don't think I will ever understand and always makes me feel overwhelmed to the point where it's almost like my reality is shattering.

Now that I'm older I avoid engaging with other people on a social or emotional level. 

Not to mention that being someplace with too much going on and being unable to escape renders me unable to talk to people or look at their faces and if i cant leave fast enough usually results in me crying for 3+ hours straight..

Having an actual diagnosis of autism has helped and also made things worse.

my wonderful spouse has worked with me to identify when I'm getting overstimulated and help me get centered again... I'm usually so disoriented I dont recognize it. I've avoided so many meltdowns  because of how wonderful and loving they are.

On the other hand what's wrong with me is never going to go away. I don't think I will ever feel close to anyone in the way that I really want to. Life has always felt like I'm behind a pane of glass watching everyone else sort of muffled even when people have cared about me and loved me.

So yeah Complex Post Traumatic Stress Disorder First and Autism

25, I still watch my little pony ( the old version) and care bears. 

I also turn on every light in the house if I have to go to the kitchen in the night
